notes.title: The BIG Update is here! Voice-Acting, Figurines, More Languages and more!
notes.notes:
Celebrate one year of The Bunny Graveyard with this new FREE update, available NOW! 
Well, maybe it's a bit too late to celebrate but... better late than never!

FULL VOICE-ACTING
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/e2e21df3e0484e87f2f78dcec4d60807094e531d.gif

For the first time ever, The Bunny Graveyard features full voice-acting. Now you can replay the game and listen to all your favorite characters talk to each other. And guess what? Aside from adding voices, I also tuned-up all of the animations to add even more personality to the characters you all know and love.

FIGURINES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/6cf1ddfb199d88557f2e8b7cc7aa7666bae4355a.gif

A new type of collectible has been added! FIGURINES are little statues of every single character that's been featured in the game, you can collect them all by purchasing them with you Bun-Buns. What are Bun-Buns you ask?

Bun-Buns are the game's currency (Don't worry, they're free) you can get them by playing minigames and exploring around the levels to find Bun-Bun bags. You can also earn Bun-Buns by completing achievements! Complete an achievement and access the new in-game achievements menu to claim your prize!

NEW SCENES!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/7f4de1830412bd325d5e94591d61630c8ba783b4.gif

Some new animated cut-scenes have been added! I wanted to add these new scenes to the game to show how much I've improved and give you a look at what you should expect for the sequel! Hope you like them!

MORE LANGUAGE OPTIONS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/5b2b4726635c0aae2b2f286b0288f90c188a8cd5.gif

We got more languages now! You can now play the entire game in the following languages:

 Brazilian Portuguese
 French
 Italian
 Japanese
 Korean
 Swedish
 Polish

Keep in mind that the dub for the voice-acting is English-only!

AND MORE!

 You can now adjust the game's audio volume
 New visual changes to the UI
 A new secret post-credit scene
 Improvements to the listening sections with hints added
 In-game achievements menu with prizes
 Tons of bug fixes
 And whatever else I added but forgot to put here because there's just way too many things in this update!


A few words!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/5452fb4d09a6949fc7c2d832c40c64564a70b14c.png

I can't believe that after the long wait, it's finally here. Thank you all for your patience! I hope you enjoy this new update, while you wait for The Bunny Graveyard II! I wanted to make this update to show my appreciation for your support the past year, without you guys, we would not be here right now, and I mean that! It's been a crazy ride, but REMEMBER, it has only just begun... Also, feel free to report any bugs you find in this update on the forums, I had to change lots of stuff to make it work with the Nintendo Switch port, but thankfully most of the nasty bugs we found were fixed in time. 

I want to give a quick shout-out to all the new and wonderful people who helped me make this update happen, because without them this game wouldn't be as awesome as it is right now:

Additional Music: Damir-Ali Yusupov / Alidaster

Voice Actors: Courtney Chu, Jason Norris, Aloysius Franklin, Laura Challender, Jesse Pinnick, Lanna Rose

Additional Character Designs: Matthew Alvarez

Localization: Active Gaming Media, Inc., Daniele ''Bollazza'' Bolis, Vignett, Manon Fauries, Daniel ''Zawdan'' Zawadzki, Łukasz Kontarski ''KiVio'', Lorenzo ''The SaruKage'' Irizarry Arana, Eueeeeeeeek, Felicia Almén ''EmoBeanie'', Erik_Spyro

QA: Szymon Breński ''Brenia'', Mason Cowan, Luciano Sigilli ''Oswald'', Active Gaming Media, Inc.

That's it, have fun playing!

- Kenneth Alvarez "ElPichon"

notes.title: Gardener Skye Plushie! + The BIG update approaches...
notes.notes:
Hey there, partner! I'm a plushie now!

[previewyoutube=OlSaSUBcgQ8;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out this limited edition Skye plushie, available now on Makeship! A lot of you were asking for a Skye plush so here she is, but remember! Since this is a Makeship plush, we're gonna need your help! If you can get us to 200 pre-orders, she will be real! Otherwise, she will be consumed by the void and never to be seen in this earth EVER AGAIN...

If you want to keep supporting the development of this game, make sure to get one of these cute lil' plushies! It helps us a lot.

You can get one here!

Just look at her! She's so GORGEOUS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/f9fcb33692c23b534eea2b76bf689295c6256ddf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/3f66ddeb9bb25808eda1eae77e8dcc042fb4ecae.png

The BIG Update approaches...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/2c503b8fdad66d0766fb0d754f39b2bce92eec69.gif

The new The Bunny Graveyard update is coming this December! This will be the version that is currently available on consoles. This update includes the newly added voice-acting, improved animations, new collectibles, new languages and more! 

The update itself is pretty much done but for SOME REASON, it started bugging out on PC, so I need to take some time to fix these issues. But once I'm done with that, it'll release for free for everyone who owns the game currently. So stay tuned, cause the update could drop any day now...

Other stuff!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/ae6047f80c8f7c94b3a108af39f221faa5806005.png

I wanted to take this time and update y'all on the sequel! We're still working hard on it and we expect to give you all a first look soon, but for now... I'll stay quiet and just work on it. Once TBG II gets PROPERLY revealed I'm gonna go back to the usual development updates since I know you guys miss those, lol.

I know some of you might be worried since now I'm doing more console ports for the first game, but I just want more people to know about TBG! I think it's a great way to introduce TBG to more audiences and I also just love utilizing the console's gimmicks to make the experience more immersive. I'm never leaving PC behind though, after all this is where it all started! They're also not very hard to make, but they can be a liiiil' bit time consuming.

I've also just been very secretive about the sequel because I want to make sure it's done right, 'cause I'm not going to lie... the pressure is much higher than last time. I feel like I've improved so much over the years as an artist, programmer and maybe not so much as a musician but I'm getting there. I truly believe that TBG II is gigantic step up from the last, and I know you guys are gonna love it.

In the meantime, expect some ports, maybe some merch and some fun surprises that we're cooking up behind the scenes!

- Kenneth Alvarez "ElPichon"

notes.title: The Bunny Graveyard: Development Update [February 2024]
notes.notes:
It's time for a new development update, we've been working on a lot of stuff behind the scenes so let's talk about some of it, shall we?

The Bunny Graveyard is coming to Nintendo Switch!

[previewyoutube=FqKiEo00uNM;full][/previewyoutube]

If you didn't know already, The Bunny Graveyard is on its way to Nintendo Switch. But this port will not just be any normal port, the game will receive some enhancements and changes both visually and gameplay-wise. Including motion-controls, HD vibration and more!

But do not worry PC users, even though some gameplay features will be exclusive to Switch, any content updates, improvements and future chapters will be released at the same time on all platforms. 


More languages!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/226e6f082252463df562298116ad959527deee7a.png

The Bunny Graveyard: Chapter 1 is currently being translated to more languages, some of these are:


 Brazilian Portuguese
 French
 Russian
 Japanese
 Simplified Chinese
 Korean
 ...and more!



Boxers Plushie!

[previewyoutube=KuPvYVNjyAI;full][/previewyoutube]

You probably heard of this already, but yes! Boxers got himself his very own plushie, which is still available at the time of this writing, however, this is a limited edition plushie so make sure to grab one before they're gone. As of right now, there's still 8 days left, so think about it! You guys absolutely CRUSHED that funding goal by the way, 450 sold so far!

We're definitely making another one... hehe.

This is also our first piece of merchandise and we're open to do more merch stuff in the future! But for now we'll only be choosing things that don't slow us down during development. So, if you got any requests for merch, let us know and we'll look into it!


NEW free content is coming this year...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/bb2ac8f9e73a7cd9b66e3e4b08aca012ab018319.png

We are working on a new secret project for the game, it will be released as a free content update at the same time as the Nintendo Switch release. It's a small thing that we wanted to make for a while now, but never got the chance to do due to time constraints. Think of it as the next "4-1-1992" for now.

We'll be releasing a separate trailer for this soon, so stay tuned!

So... how's Chapter 2?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/cecbb68500a22edc235fba243ae8cc3fd205e136.png

Finally, let's have a quick talk about Chapter 2. 

We are still not ready to fully reveal Chapter 2, buuuut we can tell you a little bit about it. It is the most ambitious project we have ever done, we expect it to be about the same length as Chapter 1, but despite the length, this chapter has proven to be quite a challenge to develop... but you know us, we love ourselves a challenge! 

The story has been fully written, the gameplay has been finalized, but there's still quite a lot of programming to go, and don't get me started on all the music and animations left. Oh, did I also mention that this chapter will be releasing at the same time on Nintendo Switch and PC? And that it will also release in multiple languages? And that I'm still working on this game mostly by myself? 

Yeah, things are not the same as they were back when I was making Chapter 1, The Bunny Graveyard is no longer just a silly lil' indie game, but that's exactly what makes it fun. I seriously can't wait to show you guys what we've been working on, this chapter is going to blow you away. Expect a trailer sometime this year.

You can add Chapter 2 to your wishlist now!


Final Thoughts!

2024 is looking like an awesome year for this game, I'm hoping that this year we can get more people to know about this game.

I'm extremely thankful for all of the support that we've been getting lately, it's crazy that I can now FINALLY focus on this game full-time, something that I've been trying to do for a long time now. I'm still processing the fact that this game is coming to the Switch, but it really is! Truly a dream come true.

If you got any questions, ask in the comments and I'll try to answer as many as I can! And as always, thank you all!

- Ken "ElPichon"

notes.title: The final update approaches...
notes.notes:
Hello! I wanted to apologize for the wait for 1.3.0, we were planning on releasing it this month but it's taking us a little bit longer than expected. The final update for Chapter 1 will be releasing sometime next month now, it will include localization support, as well as a Spanish version of the game and many other fixes.

I'm also aware of a big issue that has been affecting many players and it's related to the headphones sections. I realized that the engine we're using to make the game does not support audio device changes while in-game, that means you can't plug in your headphones while playing the game, you need to have them on before starting up the game or the audio will not play. Unfortunately I don't know how to fix this issue, so instead I will be completely reworking the headphones sections so they no longer require you to use your headphones.

Thank you for your patience.

- Ken "ElPichón"

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 | PS4/PS5/Switch Controller Support and More!
notes.notes:
IMPORTANT: If you have played the game before version 1.2.0, you may have to rebind your controllers again in the main menu. If so, you must use the default controls to navigate to the SETTINGS option in the main menu and use the CHANGE CONTROLS option to rebind your keys.  


 Added support for PS5, PS4, Switch Controllers and more
 You can now freely switch between Keyboard and Gamepad controls during gameplay
 You can now manually select which key you want to change in the controls menu
 Controls menu layout has changed


GAMEPAD:

 All gamepad controllers now support vibration (You can disable controller vibration in the Settings menu)
 Player movement has been changed to strict 8-directional movement for Gamepad controllers
 You can now use the D-Pad to move the player
 You can now assign Joystick presses to the Action, Interact and Run keys
 Vibration effects were added for Xbox controllers for some sections


KEYBOARD:

 You don't have to choose between WASD and arrow keys for movement when rebinding controls anymore.
 You can now assign different keys to the movement controls.
 You can now assign TAB, CTRL, Arrow Keys, W,A,S,D and Number keys to the Interact, Action and Run keys.



OTHER FIXES:

 Fixed a bug where a button would spawn twice in the Gardening section
 Some menu inputs have been fixed
 Visual cues for the listening sections have been slightly adjusted (Increased size and adjusted speed of audio waves that come from the cursor's fingertip)
 Fixed some visual bugs with the Stamina bar
 Code for the saving system has been completely reworked, should still be compatible with Steam Cloud and previous versions of the game. If not, please let us know!


More updates coming soon!
